CONTROLS.NAME: melt_depth
CONTROLS.LABEL: Melt depth
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets how far the artwork sags and how much wax a beat sheds.

CONTROLS.NAME: gravity
CONTROLS.LABEL: Gravity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes how quickly the shed pigment falls.

CONTROLS.NAME: drip_life
CONTROLS.LABEL: Drip life
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes how long the falling wax keeps its colour.

CONTROLS.NAME: rivulets
CONTROLS.LABEL: Rivulets
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the spacing of the channels that draw wax from the artwork.

CONTROLS.NAME: warmth
CONTROLS.LABEL: Wax warmth
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blends amber into the pigment sampled from the artwork.

CONTROLS.NAME: backdrop
CONTROLS.LABEL: Backdrop
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the strength of the surrounding molten currents.

CONTROLS.NAME: demo_stamp
CONTROLS.LABEL: Demo stamp
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Show a built-in wax stamp when no Nested artwork is active.
